text:
UU401
Germany Today and the Legacy of Nazism: An Interdisciplinary Approach
0.5 Credit
This
course
consists of two intensive, weekend seminars, combined with individual (or group) projects supervised by a member of the
UU400
committee. The course is open to
students
in most
disciplines
, for example sociology, anthropology, languages and literatures, history. Submission of an application to the committee required.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Year 4 student with a minimum GPA of 9.00.
Notes
Irregular course
